text_block_list.text: At summer training camp, Air Groove ran along beach for days.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph... 20km completed before I even realized.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Manageable distance now. Unstable sand trains stamina and core simultaneously.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Unmatched for dirt conditioning. Peak form. Confident against any rival—Hm?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. Summer festival has already begun.
Right, she had student council patrol duty at festival...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Many students unfamiliar with off-campus environment. For their safety, I must depart.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Accompany if you wish... Strictly business.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Understood? Then follow.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Cotton candy, takoyaki, candy carrots... Good grief. Excessive temptation for athletes in training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Said I am strictly here on duty, fool! Have you lost your memory?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Zero intention of indulging... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Uwah! U-Um, please stop...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Just quick shot! Lemme take your picture! Tracen girls, right? Future stars!
Reporter flashing camera at students...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Insolent.
Seeing Air Groove's temper flare, instinctively stepped forward.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. Stand down. I shall handle this.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Trainer, stay there and observe.
With that, Air Groove marched toward reporter.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. You, reporter.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Eh? What... Are you... "Empress" Air Groove?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Regardless of your affiliation, academy policy strictly requires prior permission for interviews.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Rule exists to protect privacy and futures of our students. Comply immediately.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Ah, my apologies... Writing for Uma Musume fan magazine, so...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Hobby became job. Saw top prospects and got carried away...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Your enthusiasm is appreciated.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Which is precisely why you must apply through proper channels. Formal requests will be granted proper consideration.
Subdued by Air Groove's dignified composure, reporter apologized and left.
Her measured restraint left strong impression on me...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Time for patrol shift swap. Duty concludes here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Could return to dorms directly, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm. Fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Follow me. I know prime vantage point.
From hilltop, city night view spread wide. Away from festival roar, only fireworks echoed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That flower bloomed thanks to dedicated support. Worthy lesson to heed.
choice_data_list: If it's you, I think even fireworks will bloom
If it's you, I think even fireworks will bloom

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sky-blooming flower, huh... No easy feat. Yet one day, surely—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah... Still, truly breathtaking.
Air Groove narrowed eyes, firework sparks reflected in her gaze.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Staring at what?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey, do not blush. Makes me... feel awkward as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Fireworks have ended. Let us return to dorms.
She turned briskly to leave, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah...
Air Groove stumbled, catching foot on stone step.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Tch, minor triviali—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...No. Wait.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Could you... carry me?
Knelt before her, supporting sprained foot.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Stay still and answer me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: In your eyes, what kind of figure do I cast?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Understood. Then I shall maintain absolute pride.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Your reliability has yet to fully blossom. ...Though I hold high expectations for your growth.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I shall give full support. As long as you strive to stand beside me, I will lead us to royal supremacy as "Empress."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Now hurry and carry my shoes.
Proud smile outshone day we first met...
